_comment: Branch protection payload for `main` (#371). Apply via .github/scripts/apply-branch-protection.sh. PRs are required, but required_approving_review_count is 0 because this is a single-maintainer repo — bumping to 1 would lock the owner out of merging their own PRs without a second reviewer. Raise once a second maintainer joins. CI checks `all-checks` (CI workflow aggregate) and `Analyze (javascript-typescript)` (CodeQL) must pass; the branch must be up to date with main before merging (`strict: true`). Force-push, deletion, and stale-review dismissal are all locked down. Administrators (the owner) are intentionally not enforced — leaves an escape hatch for break-glass fixes; revisit if abused.
